gem_value_table.description: Roll d20 to determine individual gem value

jewellery.description: Each piece of jewellery is worth 3d6 × 100gp
jewellery.damaged_description: Rough treatment (crushing, fire, lightning) reduces value by 50%

notes.combining: When multiple gems/jewellery are indicated, the referee may combine values. Example: five 50gp gems may become a single 250gp gem.
notes.higher_level: For characters above 3rd level, the referee may wish to increase jewellery values.
